### Understanding Veterinary Clinic Economics

| Revenue Stream | Typical Margin | Relevance to Company |
|---------------|---------------|---------------------|
| Consultation fees | 80-90% | Indirect (compliance drives visits) |
| Pharmaceutical sales | 30-50% | Direct (our products) |
| Prevention programs | 40-60% | High (recurring revenue) |
| Surgery | 70-80% | Indirect |
| Dental procedures | 70-80% | Direct (company dental range) |
| Retail (food, accessories) | 20-30% | Low |
